page.overview:
What is Aeldari?

The Aeldari (Eldar) are a dwindling psychic species whose empire fell to Slaanesh; Craftworlds, Drukhari, and Harlequins survive amid the ruins of their glory.

Also known as: Eldar, Aeldari Empire.
